GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-08-03T00:20:32Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Use lib/lib.*.d.ts as regular program files
Description: We use the same `tsconfig.json` `compilerOptions` for all code in our monorepo.
Each target gets to specify only the `files` list.

We'd like some targets to be able to opt-in for typings like collections. In the past, we did that by including the DefinitelyTyped es6-collections.d.ts in the files.

If I include one of the `///<reference no-default-lib=true/>` files, though, I get an error:

```
alexeagle@alexeagle:~/Projects/repro$ cat tsconfig.json 
{
    "compilerOptions": {
        "module": "commonjs",
        "target": "es5"
    },
    "files": ["node_modules/typescript/lib/lib.es2015.collection.d.ts"]
}
alexeagle@alexeagle:~/Projects/repro$ $(npm bin)/tsc
error TS2318: Cannot find global type 'Array'.
error TS2318: Cannot find global type 'Boolean'.
error TS2318: Cannot find global type 'Function'.
error TS2318: Cannot find global type 'IArguments'.
error TS2318: Cannot find global type 'Number'.
error TS2318: Cannot find global type 'Object'.
error TS2318: Cannot find global type 'RegExp'.
error TS2318: Cannot find global type 'String'.
```

This is the case even if other files are included in the compilation. I can solve it by removing the `///ref` but this means we have local modifications to Typescript. Is there another way to defeat the error?
